The term "daily respawn" in Tibia generally refers to an item that can be collected once or several times in a day.

A list of known daily item respawns can be found below. Note that some of these items might spawn after a Floor Reset or a Server Save and some only spawn after a big update.

New Player Areas

Newhaven

  • 2 Carrots spawn next to Viola on a Small Table.
  • 1 Grapes spawn inside Viola's house on a Small Round Table.
  • 1 Inkwell spawn next to Flavius.

Dawnport

  • 5 Worms, 1 Cookie, 1 Flour and 3 Simple Arrows spawns on the top floor of the Adventurer's Outpost, in the northeast tower (32070, 31885, 3), inside the containers.
  • 1 Leather Legs and 1 Leather Armor in a Bamboo Drawer spawns on the dorms at the top floor of the Adventurer's Outpost, in the southeast tower. Access requires Key 0010.

Rookgaard

Note: Rookgaard respawns may be on the free or premium sides.

  • Milk, 1 Vial, 1 Mace, Spears, Gold Coins and other items spawn in the Chain Armor Quest room.
  • Salmon spawns in Captain Iglues Treasure Quest room.
  • 1 Poison Arrow, 1 Scythe, Food and other items spawns in the Minotaur Mage room (32114, 32053, 12) (inaccessible).
  • 1 Small Axe, for the Pick Quest, spawns
    • in the room above the Minotaur Hell Quest,
    • in a box (32090, 32120, 10) in the orc cave, together with 4 Arrows
    • in a room (31986, 32221, 12) with a Minotaur near the goblins (premium side),
    • on a rock (31976, 32221, 8) in the premium troll cave (premium side).
  • 13 Flour spawns in Billy's mill on the premium side.
  • 2 Small Stones spawn right by the stairs (32093, 32132, 8) underground at the entrance of North Ruin.

Free Areas

Ab'Dendriel

  • 5 Wheat and 20 Flour spawn west from the weapon shop in the bakery (32644, 31654, 8).
  • Numerous Star Herb and Flowers spawn in the garden area (32696, 31699, 7) southeast of depot.
  • 1 Blue Rose, 1 Red Rose, 1 Tulip and other Flowers spawn east of the paladin ammunition shop on the wedding hill (32708, 31603, 5).
  • 3 Small Stones spawn inside the Sweaty Cyclops' house.
  • 10 Wheat, 1 Pick, 1 Shovel and 1 Candlestick spawn in the Ab'Dendriel Slimes Cave.

Blue Valley

  • 3 Bunches of Ripe Rice, 1 Flour, 1 Wheat, 3 Rice Balls, 1 Bread and 4 Blueberries spawn near Dajcho The Monk.

Carlin

  • 1 Inkwell and 1 Wooden Hammer spawn in the jail (32383, 31779, 7).
  • 1 Orange spawns over the potion shop (32349, 31830, 6).
  • 2 Red Roses spawn near the chess boards (32304, 31773, 7).
  • 1 Red Rose and Grave Flowers spawn on the graveyard east of town.

Fields of Glory

  • 3 Grave Flowers and 1 Red Rose spawn in the Graveyard of the Red Legion, north of the Forest Fury Camp.
  • 3 Fish and 1 Rope inside a corpse spawns in a troll cave south of Lothar.
  • 4 Ham, 6 Fish and 1 Cheese spawn inside some Barrels in the west storage room of the Troll cave that leads to the Maze of Lost Souls.
  • 5 Ham and 7 Fishes spawn inside some Barrels in the east storage room of the Troll cave, near Northport's entrance, north of the Lever needed to access the Maze of Lost Souls.
  • 4 Wooden Shields, 4 Spears and 4 Clubs spawn over a table in a room of the Troll cave, west of the entrance to the Maze of Lost Souls.
  • 1 Small Stone spawns in the Wolf den, northwest of the Troll cave.

Maze of Lost Souls

  • 1 Hand Axe spawns in upper levels.
  • Many Small Stones spawn throughout the maze.
  • 60 Gold spawn alongside a Dragon in one of the dead ends.
  • 1 Basket spawns around some Snakes.

Northport

  • 4 Carrots and 3 Corncobs spawn in a Chicken pen, next to Marlene.

Lumberjack Mini World Change

  • 1 Small Axe and 1 Saw spawn in the changed area (next to Chip in the first day, and to the Amazons the next day after someone report him to Queen Eloise).

Dusalk's Troll Clan Cave

  • 4 Small Stones and 1 Vial spawn under the garbage on the ground level.
  • 1 Sword, 1 Studded Helmet and 1 Club spawn in the east room on the first level, just south of the entrance.
  • 1 Bucket, as well as 1 Leather Legs in a Box, spawn in a north room on the first level, just west of the entrance.
  • 1 Meat on a Plate and 1 Spear over a bag spawn before the Bug room on the first level.
  • 12 Troll Greens, 2 Red Mushrooms, 2 Small Stones, 1 Stone Herb and 1 Mouldy Cheese spawn in the bug room on the first level.
  • 1 Dark Mushroom spawns near Poison Fields at the south of the first level.
  • 2 Gold Coins spawn on a Small Table near the east stairs to the second level.
  • 1 Studded Shield and 1 Axe spawn on a Small Table near the west stairs to the second level.
  • 1 Leather Boots in the ground and 1 Rope inside a Crate spawn in the west dorm room in the second level.
  • 1 Lump of Dough spawns near an Oven in the northwest dorm in the second level.
  • 1 Brown Mushroom spawns near a grave on the second level.
  • 1 Backpack, 1 Lamp, 1 Pick, 5 Small Stones and 1 White Mushroom spawn in the southern most cave of the second level.
  • 3 Meats spawn in a Box (Brown) in the southwest room in the second level.
  • 1 Watch, 1 Ham, 1 Red Apple and 1 Stone Herb spawn near the Minotaur Mage.
  • 1 Katana spawns near the entrance of the ritual room in the second level.
  • 1 Small Axe, 1 Vial and 1 Knife spawn in the ritual room in the second level.

Femor Hills

  • A Box with 3 Salmon, 7 Fish and some garbage spawns on the way to the Power Ring Quest room.
  • 3 Red Apples spawn with 1 Pig two floors above the Power Ring Quest room.
  • 2 Hams spawn in the Power Ring Quest room on a Campfire, around here (32604, 31784, 9).
  • 9 Red Apples spawn with some Pigs south of the Power Ring Quest room.
  • 1 Pick spawn in the tunel 2 floors above ground near some Goblin Scavengers.
  • 66 Gold Coins spawn inside a Stone Coffin in the Demon Skeleton cave, below Femor Hills Tower.

Fibula

  • 1 Baking Tray spawns in the mill at the north exit.
  • 30 Wheat spawns in the barn, north of Timur, between the Guildhouse of the Red Rose and the Mercenary Tower.
  • 3 Small Stones spawn along the shore east of town, reached through walking along the north exit. One of them in particular is under Stones, needing to Browse Field to get it.

Fibula Dungeon

  • 5 Small Stones spawn around the Orc cave, northeast of the Stairs.
  • 3 Small Stones spawn in the end of the Rotworm cave, near the river.
  • 21 Small Stones spawn through the Bonelord cave, south of the Stairs.

Deeper Fibula

  • 1 Sling Herb, 1 Blank Rune, 1 Dark Mushroom, 1 Vial and 1 Spoon spawn after Fire Fields and Energy Fields west of the entrance, near some Minotaur Mages before the Key 3980.
    • West of the Minotaur Mages, there is a Crate after two Energy Fields with 1 Blue Rose, 1 Orange Mushroom, 1 Fern, 1 Star Herb, 1 Tulip and some junk, just above the hole that contains the Key 3980.
  • 1 Meat, 1 Ham over a Table and 3 Troughs with Milk spawn in the first room after the door of the Key 3980.
  • 3 Small Stones, 2 Picks, 1 Rope, 1 Lamp and 1 Bag spawn in the second room, before the Dragons and Dragon Lords.
  • 6 Small Stones spawn in the quest room, alongside the Dragons and Dragon Lords.

Green Claw Swamp

  • 1 Green Mushroom spawns west of the single Witch spawn.
  • 1 Green Mushroom spawns next to the Blood Herb Quest tree.
  • 1 Vial of Water, as well as 1 Baking Tray inside a Crate, spawn in the Voodoo Doll Quest room.
  • Goat Grass, Some Mushrooms and Some Mushrooms (Brown) spawn near the 2 Witch spawn.
  • 1 Plate, 1 Cup, 1 Vial of Water, 2 Mouldy Cheese in Crate, 1 Scythe in a Crate, 1 Rope, 1 Lamp, 1 Pot of Oil, 1 Wooden Spoon in the open, 1 Broom, 3 Breads in a Barrel, 3 Wooden Spoons in a Barrel and 2 Oranges in a Barrel spawn in and around Wyda's house in easily accessible areas.
  • 3 Grave Flowers spawn right below Wyda's house.
  • Also a Basket and 4 Cookies spawn in Wyda's house behind a locked door.
  • Near Wyda's house are 4 accessible Shadow Herbs (e.g. here (32737, 31986, 7), east of witch hill), 4 accessible Powder Herbs (e.g. here (32751, 31981, 7)), 1 inaccessible Shadow Herb, 1 accessible Sling Herb (on witch hill), 1 accessible Star Herb (on witch hill), 1 inaccessible Powder Herb and 1 inaccessible Blood Herb.
  • 1 Steel Shield, 1 Soldier Helmet, 1 Chain Armor, 1 Studded Legs and 1 Document spawns on the hill (32728, 32015, 6) with 2 Slimes.
  • 1 Mug of Lifefluid spawns on a table near a Witch and a Bonelord, here (32763, 32019, 7).

Villa Scapula

  • 1 Jacket spawn in the Slime room.

Greenshore

  • 2 Melons, 7 Carrots, 3 Corncobs and 12 Sling Herbs spawn in the fields (32235, 32054, 7) west of the town, along with Blueberry Bushes that grant 54 Blueberries. They don't spawn during the Insectoid Invasion World Change.
  • 1 Rope and 1 Bucket spawn on The Tibianic.

Ice Islands

Folda

  • 1 Plate Shield spawn along some common Trolls (not Frost Trolls).
  • 1 Brown Bread spawn along some Minotaurs on the room before the Chest with the Key 4503.
  • 1 Spear spawn along some Minotaurss on another room after the Chest with the Key 4503.

Senja

  • 1 Vial spawn in Senja Castle.

Vega

  • Flour and other kitchen Tools spawn in the Christmas Bakery, but only after an update. (Vega does not experience floor resets.)

Isle of the Kings

  • 4 Grapes spawn in the east backyard.
  • 6 Grapes spawn in the west backyard.
  • 7 Cookies spawn in the first underground floor.
  • 1 Backpack, 1 Present and 1 Pick spawn in the second underground floor.
  • Other items spawn in the third underground floor.
  • 2 Inkwells spawns next to Costello, 1 is in a Drawer.

Jakundaf Desert

  • Small Stones spawn through the desert. Notable places include:
    • 2 Small Stones east of the oasis.
    • 1 Small Stone southeast of Para Norbert.
    • 1 Small Stone east of the Desert Dungeon entrance.
    • 2 Small Stones northeast of Adrenius temple.
    • 1 Small Stone just south of the Demon Tower House
    • 1 Small Stone between the Demon Tower House and the Triangle Tower Lever.
    • 2 Small Stones south of the Triangle Tower Lever.

Desert Dungeon

  • 1 Small Diamond (northwest corner of the trash room), 8 Vials, 4 Arrows and 3 Bolts spawn near Hagor.
  • 1 Scarf, 1 Leather Legs, 1 Leather Boots, 1 Jacket and 1 Backpack with 1 Rope, 1 Shovel and 1 Torch spawn in a dead body next to a Poison Spider, up the ladder next to the entrance (32646, 32095, 12).

Kazordoon

  • A Chest with 39 Gold Coins, 1 Blank Rune and 1 Sword can be found on the room of the solitary Bonelord.
  • 18 Wheat and 16 Flour (3 on the floor and 13 inside Bags) spawn near the wheat fields (32619, 31920, 2).
  • 8 Fish can be found at the start of the river, after the elevator.
  • 1 Meat, 1 Inkwell and 1 Rope spawn in the emperor's room (32645, 31908, 3).
  • 3 Small Stones spawn east of the south exit of the Dwarf Bridge.

Dwarf Mines

  • Various items spawn on most of the mine entrances west of Kazordoon.
    • 1 Pick, 1 Shovel, 3 Used Lamps, 3 Torches, 7 Bags and 2 Axes in the Old Ore Mine, on the way of the Iron Ore Quest.
    • 1 Pick, 1 Rope, 1 Shovel, 1 Wooden Hammer, 3 Used Lamp|s, 1 Torch and 2 Bags in Splintered Stone Mine, near Budrik.
    • 1 Pick, 2 Ropes, 1 Wooden Hammer, 2 Small Axes, 2 Used Lamps, 2 Bags and 1 Scroll in Bridge Ledge Mine.
    • 1 Pick, 2 Ropes, 1 Small Axe, 2 Used Lamps, 3 Torches, 4 Bags and 1 Hatchet in Pick 'N Shovel Mine.
    • 1 Pick, 1 Rope, 1 Shovel, 1 Wooden Hammer, 2 Small Axe, 1 Used Lamp, 3 Torches, 1 Bag, 1 Club and 1 Broom in Diggers Depths Mine, near Jagran.
    • 1 Pick, 1 Rope and 1 Shovel can be found near a Campfire some levels below Kazordoon.
    • 1 Dwarven Pickaxe in Drunken Fellow Mine, south of the Kazordoon Minotaurs lair.
  • Dwarven Pickaxes can be found through the mines.
  • 1 Small Ruby and other small gems can be taken from the walls in some deeper Dwarf Guard levels.

Kazordoon Minotaurs Lair

  • 8 Bags containing 4 Meat, 8 Red Apples, 4 Ham, 3 Salmon, 7 Wheat, 5 Flour, 7 Cherries and 6 Breads can be found on the center of the second underground floor of the Kazordoon Minotaurs.
  • 1 Gold Coin spawn in the second floor north room along 2 Minotaur Guards.

Mount Sternum

  • 10 Fish, 10 Salmon and 4 Leather Boots spawn at the Fishing Hut southeast of Mount Sternum.
  • 1 Vial of Blood, 1 Jacket, 1 Leather Legs and 1 Leather Boots spawn in a corpse on the room with 2 Demon Skeletons.
  • 1 White Pearl, 1 Lyre and some Arrows spawn in the Crown Helmet Quest room.
  • 3 Small Stones spawn on the east side of the lava blocked passage on the surface. They spawn on the same tile but as separate items.
  • 1 Inkwell spawns in Lubo's house.

Orc Lands

  • 1 Spear spawns inside the watchtower on the ground floor, near the area's entrance.
    • 1 Drum spawns atop the watchtower.
  • 3 Meat and 2 Ham spawn inside a small cave north of the Orc Fortress.
Ulderek's Rock (Orc Fortress)
  • 2 Meat and 3 Ham spawn along some Dead Deer in the fourth floor of the northeast mountain which houses the Strange Powder for the The Orc Powder mission of the The Explorer Society Quest quest.
  • 1 Scale Armor, 2 Studded Helmets, 2 Studded Legs, 4 Spears, 1 Leather Armor and 1 Leather Helmet spawn over some counters on the first floor underground.
  • 1 Rope and 3 Empty Vials spawn on a counter in the last floor underground, along the Stone Golem and the Orc Shamans, inside the dining hall.

Outlaw Camp

  • 1 Kitchen Knife spawns on ground floor of Rottin Wood's house. It can be used in Rottin Wood's repeatable quest.
  • 1 Power Ring, 2 Vials of Oil and a Mug of Oil spawn in the Wild Warrior caves (32624, 32184, 8).
  • 1 White Mushroom spawns in the Slime cave.
  • 5 Small Stones spawn on the floor right before Bright Sword Quest room.
  • 4 Troughs of Oil spawn right before Bright Sword Quest room.

Plains of Havoc

  • A Chest containing 6 dead bodies, a lot of Ham, Meat, Fish, Bread, Rolls, Flour, Red Apples, Wheat, 6 Small Stones, 1 Halberd, 1 Two Handed Sword, 1 Watch, 1 Vial of Oil, 1 Blank Rune and some other items spawn in the Giant Smithhammer Quest room.
  • 1 Strong Mana Potion, 1 Fishing Rod, 1 Watch, 2 Flour, 1 Spellbook, 6 Blank Runes, 19 Vials, 2 Backpacks, Candlesticks and other items spawn in the Necromant House.
  • 1 Talon, 1 Throwing Star and Blank Runes spawn in the single Giant Spider hole.
  • Bottles with Milk and other fluids spawns in the cyclops camp.
  • A Parcel with 3 dead bodies, 1 Small Diamond, 1 Talon, 1 Small Emerald, 1 Small Amethyst, 1 Warhammer, 1 Plate Armor, 1 Steel Helmet, 1 Bow, 1 Fishing Rod, some Blank Runes, 1 Watch, some Gold Coins, some paladin ammunition and other semi-valuable items spawn around and under many fire fields in the Dragon Lair.
  • Red Roses and 12 Red Apples spawn on the Isle of the Mists.
  • 1 Fishing Rod, 1 Throwing Star, 3 Gold Coins, 1 Scarf, 1 Blank Rune 1 Pick and other minor items spawn near the A Ghostly Woman NPC.
  • 2 Red Apples, 1 Fishing Rod, other kitchen equipment and 595 (6 piles of 99) Flour (you can bake a lot of Bread there) spawns in the Dream Master room.
  • 12 Grave Flowers and 2 Goat Grass spawn in the graveyard outside the Pits of Inferno.
  • 1 Chain Armor, 1 Viking Helment, 1 Leather Legs, 1 Leather Boots and 1 Backpack containing 1 Spellbook, 1 Blank Rune and 1 Empty Vial spawn in a corpse in the first floor of the Pits of Inferno house.
  • 2 Flour and 1 Bucket, along with 1 Fishing Rod spawn inside a Barrel, spawn in the kitchen in the first flour of the Pits of Inferno house. Note that the Ghouls might destroy the barrel.
  • 3 Empty Vials and 1 Bucket spawn in a table in the second floor of the Pits of Inferno house. 15 more Empty Vials spawn inside Chests just north of the table.
  • Some Chicken Feathers, Saws and 4 Bat decorations spawn in Tafariel's throne room in the Pits of Inferno.

Shadowthorn

  • 3 Arrows spawn in the second floor of the Dragon Tower.

Thornfire World Change

  • 1 Bucket spawns in the south-east and another one in the south-west prison cells, in the first floor underground, but they are only accessible during the Thornfire World Change. They can be combined with Flask of Embalming Fluids to create Prepared Buckets to use during the world change.

Swamp Troll Cave

  • 1 Ham, 5 Meat and 2 Rolls spawn in the kitchen in the west side.
  • 1 Gold Coin spawn in the altar in the east side

Thais

  • 1 Inkwell spawns in the basement of King Tibianus' castle, Rain Castle.
  • Kitchen tools spawn in the Rain Castle kitchen.
  • 1 Inkwell spawns near Wyat at Thais Jail.
  • 1 Inkwell spawns near Jack Springer.
  • 3 Inkwells spawn on the second floor of the bank (32317, 32262, 6).
  • 2 Lumps of Dough, 2 Flour and 2 Troughs of Water spawn in the bakery (32375, 32192, 7). Ovens are present as well, so the dough and flour can be quickly made intro Bread. These do not spawn if the Kingsday Mini World Change is happening.
  • 5 Wheat and 5 Flour spawn at the mill (32383, 32176, 7) by the north gate.
  • 1 Watch and 2 Grapes spawns in the second floor of Donald McRonald's house.
  • 7 Sling Herbs spawn in the Donald McRonald's Sheep farm.
  • 12 Wheat spawn in the second floor of Donald McRonald's Chicken farm.
  • Urine spawns in Thais Hostel.
  • 1 Comb and 1 Broom spawn at Eclesius' house.
  • Manafluid from a potion stand in the Oramond area of the Time Travel Dungeon.

Ancient Temple

  • 2 Small Stones spawn in the room before Glitterscale.
  • Small Stones, Picks and Shovels spawn in the Orc region between Thais Castle and Greenshore.
  • 1 Wooden Shield, Sickle, 1 Bread as well as 10 Flour, 1 Ham and 1 Meat inside Crates on the room before the Scale Armor Quest.
  • 18 Gold Coins and 1 Rapier spawn in a small room east of the Scale Armor Quest.
  • 1 Meat as well as 10 Flour and 3 Bread spawn in the Troll region on floor -2.
  • 9 Wheat spawn in the north room of the Cyclops spawn in the Rotworm cave.
  • 3 Small Stones, 1 Pick and 1 Shovel can be found around dead Minotaurs near the Rotworms.
  • 3 Red Apples and 1 Small Stone spawn near the Throwing Star Quest.
  • 6 Spears, 1 Morning Star, 1 Chain Armor, 1 Chain Helmet, 1 Hatchet and 2 Strong Health Potions spawn near the Mintwallin Cyclops Quest.
  • 12 Spears (one in a dead orc) on the floor, 9 Grapes, 8 Rolls, 2 Axes, 13 Meat, 8 Spears and 1 Salmon spawn in the barrels in the room (32562, 32204, 12) where Orc Berserkers and other Orcs are fighting Minotaurs.
    • 10 Spears, 9 Bolts, 23 Arrows, 1 Chain Armor, 1 Leather Armor, 1 Brass Helmet, 1 Brass Shield, 1 Sabre, 3 Rolls, 2 Brown Breads, 1 Club and 1 Torch in the room (32588, 32209, 13) beneath with Minotaurs and Trolls. Some items are in Crates or Barrels.
  • 1 Silver Dagger, 2 Strong Mana Potions, 6 Blank Runes, 1 Energy Ring, 7 Throwing Stars and 1 Spellbook spawn in the Mad Mage Room Quest.
  • 58 Gold Coins spawns in the Naginata Quest room.
  • 13 Throwing Stars, 1 Brass Armor, 1 Brass Helmet, 1 Hand Axe and 1 Lamp spawn in a dead body in the Kingdom of Kormarak. This used to be the Old Mintwallin Quest.
  • 2 Small Stones spawn south of the Mintwallin access, along Poison Spiders and Poison Fields.

Mintwallin

  • 12 Ham, 15 Meat, 20 Bread, 3 vials of Milk, 78 Flour, Dough, Wheat, a Torch, a Pick, 4 Clubs, 2 Jackets, 2 Coats, 3 Pans, 1 Pitchfork, 1 Scythe, 1 Hoe, 1 Rake and 1 Shovel spawn in the royal store room.
  • 1 Wooden Hammer and 1 Inkwell spawn in the townhall.
  • 1 Crossbow and 15 Bolts spawn in the blacksmith building in a barrel.
  • 2 Brown Breads spawn in the prison. Key 3620 is necessary to open the doors.
  • 2 Small Stones and 1 Brown Mushroom span in the park east of the prison.
  • 2 Wheat and 1 Baking Tray, as well as 12 Ham, 10 Flour and 1 Lump of Dough inside Barrels, spawn in a building south of the prison, east of the wheat field.
  • 1 Shovel spawn along the the west shore.
  • 1 Small Ruby and maybe other gems under fires at the dragon spawn (See Small Ruby Quest).

Thais Surroundings

  • 5 Grave Flowers spawn in the cemetery at the north gate.
  • 1 Small Stone spawn northwest of the White Flower Temple.
  • 1 Throwing Star spawn in the White Flower Temple.
  • 1 Small Stone spawn in the 2nd floor of the Wasp Cave.
  • 1 Ham spawn over a Fire Field north of the Thais Troll Cave.
  • 1 Small Stone spawn not far from the Fire Field north of the Thais Troll Cave.
  • 10 Flour, 1 Scythe, 1 Wooden Shield, 1 Ham and 1 Meat above the Scale Armor Quest room.

Thais Troll Cave

  • 1 Small Stone spawn on the way (32475, 32265, 7) to the farmer's house.
  • 1 Inkwell and 3 Brown Bread spawn inside a farmer's house (32505, 32295, 7).
  • 3 Carrots, 4 Small Stones, 3 Cherries and 3 Melons spawn outside of the farmer's house (32515, 32306, 7).
  • 5 Hams and 1 Watch spawn on the Orc room before the old Spell Scroll Quest room.
  • 1 Small Stone spawn on the surface east side near the Wasps.
  • 1 Small Stone spawn on the north stone hill near the Scorpions.
  • 1 Small Stone spawns on the way to the Rotworm room with a circular lava lake with pillars on the second level.
  • A Chest with 132 Gold Coins on the room above the circular lava lake with pillars. To reach the room, you will need Parcels or Levitate Spell to reach it, a good spot is the bottom of the right-most black tiles, going east (for Parcel method, you will further need a Rotworm to block your way on the current room).
  • 6 Fish, 3 Ham, 1 Fishing Rod, 1 Shovel, 1 Pick, and 3 Small Stones spawn around (32524, 32276, 10) Crates near the Orcs south of the Scorpions and south of the underground water river.
  • 1 Carlin Sword and 27 Gold Coins spawn on a chest south of the underground water river.
  • 3 Small Stones spawn in the room with Rotworms, Carrion Worms and Skeletons.
  • 2 Poison Arrows and 12 Gold Coins in a corpse after the Poison Fields with a Slime, near the Dead Archer Quest.
  • 15 Gold Coins and a Crate with 1 Leather Helmet, 1 Leather Armor, 1 Leather Legs and 1 Bag spawns in a room with a single Troll Champion.
  • A Chest with 21 Gold Coins and 1 Torch in a another room.
  • 1 Salmon as well as 4 Meat and 1 Ham on the Dead Dogs spawn in the kitchen counter (acessible through both entrances).
  • 1 Small Stone spawn on the south stone hill near the farmer's house.
  • 1 Small Axe spawn in the kitchen east side entrance.
  • 2 Salmons spawns in the kitchen store room (32508, 32271, 9).

Annual Autumn Vintage World Quest

  • 6 Empty Buckets spawn in the west area of the quest room, near the Fountains. They are meant to be used during the event, but they can be taken and used for other purposes.

Venore

  • Urine spawns in most Venore bathrooms.
  • 1 Sickle and Wheat spawn west from the south gate, south of the prison (32898, 32151, 7) (you need a Machete to get there).
  • 1 Inkwell spawns in the Depot.
  • 2 Blue Roses and 1 Red Rose in Crunor's Finest Warehouse.
  • In the shipyard (32894, 32025, 7) accessible tools include 3 Ropes, 2 Small Axes, 1 Wooden Hammer, 3 Saws, 3 Kitchen Knives and 1 Hammer. You need the Levitate spell to access the Hammer and 1 of the Rope.
  • There is an abandoned house (32866, 32009, 7) north of the northwest gate. In the cellar are 1 Meat, 2 Hams and 2 Small Stones. On the main floor are 1 Meat, 1 Ham and 1 Jug of Beer. On the roof is 1 Meat. On the coast north of the abandoned house are 3 Fish along the coastline and 6 Empty Vials and 4 Salmon inside a Crate.
  • 3 Cheese, 2 Rat Cheese and 1 Soft Cheese spawn in the Bamboo Drawer and Bookcase near Ra'Clette.
  • 1 Rat Cheese spawns in the Little Corym Charlatan cave.
  • 1 Inkwell spawns near Rafzan.

Venore Dragon Lair

  • 1 Gold Coin spawns in the north alcove on the ground floor.
  • 1 Small Stone spawns in the first floor, above the alcove.
  • 2 Gold Coins spawn in the first floor of the cave below the west tower.
  • 1 Small Stone spawn in the first floor of the west tower.
  • 7 Gold Coins and 1 Small Stone spawn in the second floor of the west tower, near the Dragon Lord. One of the Gold Coins is hidden below junk.
  • 1 Gold Coin spawns in the central area of the east cave, on the first floor.
  • 3 Gold Coins spawn in the north area of the east cave, on the first floor.
  • 2 Gold Coins spawn in the east area of the east cave, on the first floor.
  • 2 Gold Coins spawn in the east tower ground floor.
  • 1 Small Stone spawns in the east tower first floor.
  • 3 Gold Coins spawn in the east tower second floor.

Yalahar

  • 1 Inkwell spawns near Palimuth.
  • 2 Inkwells spawn in the Post Office, near Redward.
  • 1 Fish spawn in the northern part of the sewers.

Magician Quarter

  • 1 Manafluid spawns in a potion stand.
  • 2 Baking Trays, 1 Ham, 1 Meat and 1 Cheese spawn in the dining hall of the southeast Dark Magician tower.
  • 1 Spellbook and 1 Blank Rune spawn on a Counter on the third floor of the northeast tower of the Blue Djinn palace.
  • 1 Oil spawns in a potion stand in the Red Wing (Ice Witches area).
  • 4 Small Pillows and 1 Water Pipe spawn in the Red Wing (Ice Witches area).

Foreigner Quarter

  • 1 Shovel spawns in an underground room in the Minotaur camp.
  • 4 Pillows and 1 Water pipe here (32730, 31352, 7).
  • 1 empty Rum Flask spawns in one of the pirate ships, next to a Rum Cask.
  • 1 White Tapestry spawns in the basement of one of the pirate ships.

Alchemist Quarter

  • 1 Oil spawns in a potion stand here (32717, 31138, 5).
  • 1 Oil spawns in a potion stand here (32697, 31167, 4).

Premium Areas

Ankrahmun

  • 1 Inkwell, 1 empty Vial, 1 Carrot, 1 Mouldy Cheese, 2 Skulls, 1 Bowl, 1 Jug, 1 Bone, 1 Twigs and 1 unit of Some Leaves spawn in the Serpentine Tower.
  • Small Stones spawn around the desert and inside the walls that surround the desert but most of them can only be picked after a big update (most of the desert doesn't have floor resets).
  • 1 Piercing Bolt outside, as well of 1 Rope, 1 Shovel and 1 empty Rum Flask inside the hidden crypt northwest of Ankrahmun, near the Ramp that leads to Mal'ouquah.
  • 3 Troughs of Milk spawn at the end of the Jewel Route of the Thieves Den during the Nomads Land Quest. Empty Buckets also spawn along the way in case you forgot to bring containers.
  • 2 Troughs of Milk spawn at the end of the Main Route of the Thieves Den during the Nomads Land Quest. Empty Buckets also spawn along the way in case you forgot to bring containers.

Ashta'daramai

  • 1 Bread spawns in the Blue Djinn Fortress entrance hall.
  • 2 empty Vials spawn in the kitchen. Can only be accessed by the back door, after siding with the Efreet in The Djinn War.

Oasis Tomb

  • 1 Remains of a Ghost, 1 Slain Ghoul and 1 Pile of Bones spawn in the first floor. These do not expire, and the Remains of a Ghost seems to only spawn here.

Nomads Mini World Change

  • 5 Meat spawn on a Campfire when the northern Nomad (Blue) camp spawns.

Darashia
